book.name: 1 Korid
book.title: 1 Korid Pol köp nöd u Korid nɨbi bɨ kalɨp kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka

content: Nan God nɨp ñeb
Mani ud magum gɨmim, God nɨbi bɨ kalɨp ñɨnabim manö u hagnɨg gabin. Krais Jisas nɨbi bɨ Galesia Propins mɨdpal gau kalɨp hagnö rö, kale u rö nöp gɨmim.
Kale nɨbi bɨ ke ke magöŋhalö wik añɨ añɨ ñɨn nöd u mani udpim rö u nɨŋmim rɨmnap ud ke gau lɨmim ud magum gɨmim. Anɨg gɨnabim u, yad apjakem mani nan a gem hag ajageinam.
Pen yad nɨnabin u, bɨ kale nɨŋmim bɨ aij mɨdpal gau rɨmnap hagpe, yad kalɨp köp kalɨ kƚiñ rɨk ñɨnö, kale pen köp u abe mani ñɨnabim u abe dam Jerusalem ud aröl.
Pen yɨp arep rö leinab yad ke kalɨp uɫ gɨ ud arnabin.
Pen yad Masedonia Propins u amem, mɨdpim u nɨnabin.
Amjakem, kale aip pro magö ap mɨdeinam rö löp. Yɨbaud i kalöp aip mɨdem, ram mɨnöŋ rɨmnap arnɨg gɨnö, yɨp dam adan aŋ u yube arnabin.
Kalöp yɨharɨŋ mailö sɨdö aŋ nɨŋöl arep u yɨp aij gagöp. Bɨ kub yau a geinab, am kale aip rapɨn mɨdem hainö arnabin.
Yad daun kub Epesas i mɨdem, Pedikos ñɨn kub u ap padiö nɨŋem hainö nɨnabin.
Daun kub Epesas i, Bɨ Kub wög kub gabin, pen nɨbi bɨ iru nöp yɨp jɨ nɨŋbal.
Pen Dimodi mɨdpim u auainɨm, nɨp ud aij gɨmim, nɨpe pɨñɨŋ gagnab. Nɨpe yad Bɨ kub u nɨp wög gɨpin rö nöp göp u nɨŋmim,
nɨp arö gagmim. Kale magöŋhalö nɨp ud aij gɨmim. Hainö arnɨg gainɨm u, nɨp dam adan aŋ u yuaimim, yad mɨdpin i ado gɨ aunɨm. Mam rɨmnap halö aip aunaböl a gem abad mɨdpin.
Pen mam hon Apolos nɨp manö kƚö hagem hagpin, mam rɨmnap arajal rö, aip armön a gɨpin u, pen nɨpe mɨñi nagnab. Hainö neb rö lainɨm nɨnab.
Manö naböŋ rɨmnap abe haga
Kale nɨbi bɨ nɨŋöl gɨ mɨdaimim. God nɨp nɨŋ ud pɨdöŋ gɨmim gɨ mɨdaimim. Nan ap pɨñɨŋ gagmim. Kƚö yabɨƚ gɨmim gɨ mɨdaimim.
Pen nan nɨhön nɨhön gɨnabim, nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp mɨdmagö lɨmim gɨmim.

Añ mam bɨ. Kale nɨŋbim, Grik kai Krais nɨp nɨŋ udla gau, Sɨdepanas nɨbi bɨ yam nɨpe gau nöd nɨŋ udla. Nɨŋ udöm me, nɨbi bɨ Krais lau adö mɨdpal gau kalɨp mɨdmagö löm wög gɨ ñöl gɨ nöp mɨdpal. Anɨb u, añ mam yad kalöp hagabin,
nɨbi bɨ aij anɨb gau rö abe, añ mam kale aip wög gɨpal gau abe nɨŋmim, hagöl rö nöp gɨmim.
Pen kale ap yɨp nɨŋmim rö lagö, Sɨdepanas, Podyunedas, Akaikas apöm yɨp nɨŋbal u yɨp aij yabɨƚ göp.
Anɨg gɨpal anɨbu yɨp aij göm kalöp aij göm göp. Bɨ aij anɨb gau manö hagnaböl u nɨŋ aij gɨmim.

Pen nɨbi bɨ God lau adö mɨdpal Esia Propins i, kalöp Korid nɨbi bɨ gau, “Añ mam bɨ, kale mɨdpim?” a gɨpal. Akwila nɨbi nɨpe Prisila aip kalöp Korid nɨbi bɨ, “Bɨ Kub kalöp abad mɨdeiaŋ,” a gɨpal. Nɨbi bɨ apöm ram kale ber mɨhau magum göm God nɨp sabe gɨpal gau u rö nöp hagpal.
Pen añ mam Krais lau adö mɨdpal gai i magöŋhalö, “Kale mɨdpim?” a gɨpal. Kale Bɨ Kub nɨp nɨŋ udpim rö, pen pen hag wɨhai udöl gɨ, alaun bom halumim.
Yad Pol, manö naböŋ magö i ñɨmagö yad u ke kalɨ kƚiñ rɨkem “Kale mɨdpim?” a gabin.
Nɨbi bɨ an, Bɨ Kub nɨp mɨdmagö lagnab u, pen ilön udnɨm. Anɨb u, Bɨ Kub hon, ne aumön!
Bɨ Kub hon Jisas kalöp mög nɨŋöm ud aij gɨnɨm.
Añ mam yad Krais Jisas lau adö mɨdpim gau, yad kalöp magöŋhalö mɨdmagö lɨbin. Anɨb unbö rö aij.
